title: 有效的正方形
summary: 给定平面上四个点，判断它们能否组成一个正方形。
insight: 四点共有六个两两距离；正方形恰有四条相等且非零的边，以及两条相等且为边长两倍的对角线。
pitfalls: 使用平方距离避免浮点误差

solutions.title: 排序六个平方距离
solutions.idea: 用距离多重集合直接验证正方形的边和对角线关系。
steps: 计算六对点的平方距离
确认前四个相等且大于零，后两个相等并等于边长两倍

code.java: class Solution { public boolean validSquare(int[] p1,int[] p2,int[] p3,int[] p4){int[][] points={p1,p2,p3,p4};long[] distances=new long[6];int index=0;for(int i=0;i<4;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<4;j++)distances[index++]=distance(points[i],points[j]);Arrays.sort(distances);return distances[0]>0&&distances[0]==distances[3]&&distances[4]==distances[5]&&distances[4]==2*distances[0];}private long distance(int[] a,int[] b){long x=(long)a[0]-b[0],y=(long)a[1]-b[1];return x*x+y*y;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun validSquare(p1:IntArray,p2:IntArray,p3:IntArray,p4:IntArray):Boolean{val points=arrayOf(p1,p2,p3,p4);val distances=LongArray(6);var index=0;for(i in 0..3)for(j in i+1..3)distances[index++]=distance(points[i],points[j]);distances.sort();return distances[0]>0&&distances[0]==distances[3]&&distances[4]==distances[5]&&distances[4]==2*distances[0]};private fun distance(a:IntArray,b:IntArray):Long{val x=a[0].toLong()-b[0];val y=a[1].toLong()-b[1];return x*x+y*y} }
code.cpp: class Solution { long long distance(vector<int>& a,vector<int>& b){long long x=1LL*a[0]-b[0],y=1LL*a[1]-b[1];return x*x+y*y;}public:bool validSquare(vector<int>& p1,vector<int>& p2,vector<int>& p3,vector<int>& p4){vector<vector<int>*> points={&p1,&p2,&p3,&p4};vector<long long> distances;for(int i=0;i<4;++i)for(int j=i+1;j<4;++j)distances.push_back(distance(*points[i],*points[j]));sort(distances.begin(),distances.end());return distances[0]>0&&distances[0]==distances[3]&&distances[4]==distances[5]&&distances[4]==2*distances[0];} };
